source.text: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹתהִנֵּ֤ה׀בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: The song of the ascents. Look, bless YHWH, all servants of YHWH, who stand in [the] house of YHWH in the nights.

en.L: A song of ascents. Look, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all [you] servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who stand in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the nights.
en.B: A song of ascents. Now bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, every servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who stands night after night in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. All you servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who serve in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house at night, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Cantique des montées. Voici, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, esclaves {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui vous tenez dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pendant les nuits.
fr.B: Cantique des montées. Allons, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui vous tenez nuit après nuit dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. Vous tous, serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui servez la nuit dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Wimbo wa kupanda. Tazama, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote watumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mnaosimama katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nyakati za usiku.
sw.B: Wimbo wa kupanda. Sasa mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watumishi wote wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mnaosimama usiku baada ya usiku katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Wimbo wa safari ya kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu. Ninyi nyote watumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mnaotumika usiku katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

es.L: Cántico de las subidas. {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos [{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}},] siervos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por las noches.
es.B: Cántico de las subidas. ¡{{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} ahora {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos los siervos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que noche tras noche {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!
es.R: Canto para el viaje de subida a Jerusalén. Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, siervos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{plural_you:sirven|servís}} de noche en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, ¡{{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!

vi.L: Bài ca cho những lần đi lên. Này, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi tất cả các đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là những người đứng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban đêm.
vi.B: Bài ca đi lên. Nào, hãy chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi mọi đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là những người đêm đêm đứng hầu trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Bài ca cho cuộc hành trình lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hỡi tất cả các đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là những người phục vụ ban đêm trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.L: 올라감을 위한 노래. 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 종들아, 밤마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 서 있는 자들아.
ko.B: 올라가며 부르는 노래. 밤마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 서 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 종들아, 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라!
ko.R: 예루살렘으로 올라가며 부르는 노래. 밤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 섬기는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 종들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Cântico dos degraus. Vejam, bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos [vocês,] servos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que estão de pé na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} durante as noites.
pt.B: Cântico das subidas. Agora bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todos vocês, servos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que noite após noite ficam de pé na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}!
pt.R: Canção para a subida a Jerusalém. Todos vocês, servos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que servem na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} à noite, louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: servants who stand: priests and Levites on duty
decisions.reason: To "stand" before the LORD is to serve him. Levites served in the temple by night as well as by day (1 Chronicles 9:33; 23:30). The last Song of Ascents calls them to bless the LORD.

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him
decisions.reason: When people bless (barak) the LORD, they praise him and thank him for what he is and does (124:6).

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 120:1.

decisions.choice: praise
decisions.reason: Readable says "praise" for blessing the LORD, as in 124:6.

decisions.choice: "esclaves du SEIGNEUR" (Literal), "serviteurs du SEIGNEUR" (Balanced, Readable) for ʿavdei YHWH
decisions.reason: As the French terms set for ʿeved in Psalms: "esclave" at Literal, "serviteur" at Balanced and Readable. At Literal the word shows that the Hebrew uses the same word for a slave and for one who serves God; here they are the priests and Levites on duty, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "louez" at Readable for "bless the LORD"; "bénissez" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: To bless the LORD is to praise him, as the meaning decision says; Readable uses the plainer word, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: bendecir (L, B); alabar (R)
decisions.reason: To bless (barak) the LORD is to praise and thank him. Literal and Balanced keep "bendecir"; Readable says "alabar", as the English Readable says "praise". The command is spoken to the temple servants, so it carries the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "chúc tụng" (L, B) for blessing God; "ca ngợi" (R)
decisions.reason: To bless the LORD is to praise him (see the meaning decision). "chúc tụng" is the terms note's word for blessing God; Readable says "ca ngợi" (praise), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: The servants on duty are called to praise in the plain imperative ("종들아", "송축하여라")
decisions.reason: A call to worship addressed to a group is given in the plain style of Korean poetry, as the calls to Israel in 130:7 and 131:3.

records.literal_gloss: Lift up your hands [to the] holy place and bless YHWH.

en.L: Lift up your hands [to the] holy place and bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Raise your hands toward the sanctuary, and bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Lift your hands in prayer toward the holy place and praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Levez vos mains [vers le] lieu saint et bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Levez les mains vers le sanctuaire et bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Levez les mains pour prier, tournés vers le lieu saint, et louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Inueni mikono yenu [kuelekea] patakatifu na mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Inueni mikono yenu kuelekea mahali patakatifu, mkambariki {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Inueni mikono yenu kwa maombi kuelekea mahali patakatifu na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

es.L: {{plural_you:Alcen sus|Alzad vuestras}} manos [hacia el] lugar santo y {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}} las manos hacia el santuario, ¡y {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!
es.R: {{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}} las manos en oración hacia el lugar santo, ¡y {{plural_you:alaben|alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}!

vi.L: Hãy giơ tay các ngươi lên [hướng về] nơi thánh và chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Hãy giơ tay lên hướng về nơi thánh, và chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!
vi.R: Hãy giơ tay lên cầu nguyện, hướng về nơi thánh, và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.B: 성소를 향하여 너희 손을 들고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축하여라!
ko.R: 성소를 향하여 손을 들고 기도하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라!

pt.L: Levantem as suas mãos [para o] lugar santo e bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ergam as mãos na direção do santuário e bendigam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!
pt.R: Levantem as mãos em oração na direção do lugar santo e louvem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}!

decisions.choice: lifting hands: the posture of prayer and praise
decisions.reason: People prayed and praised with raised hands, often toward the holy place of the temple (28:2; 63:5; 1 Kings 8:22).

decisions.choice: holy place: the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The word (qodesh) without a preposition is probably "toward the holy place"; it has also been read "in holiness".

decisions.choice: praise
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

source.text: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: May YHWH bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.

en.L: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.
en.B: From Zion may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who made heaven and earth, bless you.
en.R: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who made heaven and earth, bless you from Zion!

fr.L: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bénisse depuis Sion, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait le ciel et la terre !
fr.B: Que de Sion {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui a fait le ciel et la terre, te bénisse !
fr.R: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a fait le ciel et la terre, te bénisse depuis Sion !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akubariki kutoka Sayuni, muumba wa mbingu na nchi.
sw.B: Kutoka Sayuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyeumba mbingu na nchi, na akubariki.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyeumba mbingu na dunia, akubariki kutoka Sayuni!

es.L: Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te bendiga desde Sion, hacedor de los cielos y de la tierra.
es.B: Desde Sion, que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el que hizo los cielos y la tierra, te bendiga.
es.R: ¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hizo los cielos y la tierra, te bendiga desde Sion!

vi.L: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho bạn từ Si-ôn, Đấng làm nên trời và đất.
vi.B: Từ Si-ôn, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã tạo nên trời và đất, ban phước cho bạn.
vi.R: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã dựng nên trời và đất, từ Si-ôn ban phước cho bạn!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 너에게 복을 주시기를, 하늘과 땅을 지으신 분께서.
ko.B: 하늘과 땅을 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 너에게 복을 주시기를.
ko.R: 하늘과 땅을 만드신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 너에게 복을 주시기를 빈다!

pt.L: Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoe você desde Sião, o que fez os céus e a terra.
pt.B: Que de Sião {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, aquele que fez o céu e a terra, abençoe você.
pt.R: Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que fez o céu e a terra, abençoe você desde Sião!

decisions.choice: you: one person blessed
decisions.reason: "You" is singular. The servants in the temple seem to answer with a blessing on each worshiper, in the words of the priestly blessing (Numbers 6:24: "May the LORD bless you"). Those who bless the LORD (verses 1-2) are blessed by him.

decisions.choice: maker of heaven and earth: the creator of all
decisions.reason: As in 121:2, a title naming the LORD as the creator of everything; it also closes 134:3.

decisions.choice: from Zion: the end of the pilgrim songs
decisions.reason: The Songs of Ascents end with a blessing from Zion (128:5), sending the pilgrim home with the LORD's blessing.

decisions.choice: "bạn" for the one person blessed, as in Psalm 121
decisions.reason: The blessing turns to one person (see the meaning decision); "bạn" is the neutral word used for this in the published Psalm 121.

decisions.choice: "너" (singular) for the one blessed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" here is singular (meaning decision); Korean keeps the singular, as a blessing given to each worshiper in turn.

decisions.choice: abençoe você
decisions.reason: The servants in the temple bless each worshiper (m1), one person to another, so Portuguese says "você", and the line has the same words as 128:5. The Portuguese of the priestly blessing (Numbers 6:24) says "te abençoe" because there the LORD himself blesses Israel, addressed in the singular, through the priests.
